summary: Pathfinder Bancorp, Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 8.01/9.01) on September 28, 2026, announcing that its Board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.10 per voting and non-voting common share for the fiscal quarter ending September 30, 2026. Payable November 6, 2026 to holders of record October 16, 2026; no board recommendation beyond declaration, no advisor, and no premium or deal mechanics. This is a routine capital-return declaration, not a special situation; dividend continuity and payout coverage are the only items worth monitoring.
